text:
ana: Quick thread on playground structured-output / tool-calling UX. I sketched a collaboration-first flow: inline schema comments, per-field example cells, and a lightweight contract test harness. Thoughts?
mike: short take: love contract tests. We should let teams save tests as reusable snippets for CI.
tara: inline comments are great for handoffs. Suggest a comment pin on fields that can be resolved (like PR threads).
ana: (typo) meant ana: also thinking about schema versions. if you edit a function's output schema, show a small diff badge and let users pick which runs to revalidate.
mike: cool: "revalidate runs" button that runs strict mode against historical outputs and reports regressions. helpful for rollouts.
tara: UI: add a tiny timeline on the function card showing schema changes over time. click to open diff.
nana: (fixing name) ana: for the editor, support guided field descriptions (markdown), example generators, and an "autofill examples" button that synthesizes values from field types.
mike: tooling ask: export contract tests as JSON for runners. also add a quick runner that executes only on sample inputs and shows pass/fail per assertion.
tara: accessibility: comment pins must be reachable via keyboard and screen readers should announce unresolved comments count.
devops-bot: note: storing run artifacts for revalidation may increase retention costs. configure retention policy per project.
nana: ana: small microcopy: label the toggle "Strict validation (reject non-conforming)" and add helper: "Try with lint-only to preview issues."
mike: final: run history should show which schema version was active for a run and allow bulk re-run against newer schema. can we add a "mark as verified" flag when revalidated?
tara: +1. action items: ana will prototype pinned comments + version badge, mike will draft contract test export, tara will write keyboard/accessibility flows. I'll collect mocks and post to #product by EOD.
nana: ana: thanks everyone. ping me if you want to pair on the revalidation runner.
